messages:
lee: Noticed sample-bootcamp failing: Python SDK returns tool_call.result as string when json_mode+schema used; Node returns parsed object. Causes sampleapp retry to double-encode.

ana: repro steps?

lee: send Responses.create with json_mode true, tool_call schema, streaming off. Node -> part.tool_call.result is dict, Py -> JSON string.

tom: is this new after the response-mapper refactor?

natalie: likely. Py mapper deserializes top-level content but missed nested tool_call payloads. We should add nested parse on mapping.

lee: stopgap in sampleapp: normalize_tool_result(part) that json.loads on strings. Ugly but safe.

ana: add unit test comparing node vs python fixture so we don't regress.

natalie: I'll add a py sdk flag parse_nested_toolcall=true behind compat toggle and tests. Will also add retry unit to ensure no double-encode.

qa-bot: created CI job samplekit/parity-1789 :hammer_and_wrench:

lee: filed ticket DEVEX-999 with logs and minimal repro. Thanks team.

natalie: ETA for PR tomorrow AM PST. Will post link in the ticket.
